title: Product Review - iZeeker Dashcam GD-100 #4kvideo #valueformoney #dashcamreview
description:
Presenting iZeeker dashcam GD-100

Product Link -

https://www.amazon.ca//dp/B09GFTCK4J

Note - All the points made in this video are based on our personal experience of using the product. Individual user experiences may vary

About GD 100 - 

* Extraordinary Dash Cam 1080P - Simultaneous recording with superior resolution, high frame rate delivers both smoother and sharper image as well as road signs during the day and night. High definition video quality for you.

* Don’t Underestimate the Mundane - Roads often offer their own little surprises to share. With the built-in manual recording mode and still-image capture, iZEEKER GD100 dash cam is always ready to snap the extraordinary moments of your journey.

* Advanced Night Vision - The combination of F1.8 large aperture, WDR, HDR technology ensures the clarity of images at night. Eliminating the need for an auxiliary light source even in low-light environments, this car dash camera can obtain color-accurate images easily.

* Seamless Loop Recording - Different from GoPro, the newly recorded video on car camera will automatically overwrite the oldest unlocked video to ensure that the memory card has enough space to save the latest recorded and emergency videos. (SD card NOT included, 32GB-128GB Class 10 MicroSD card is recommended)

* 170° Super Wide Angle - This dash cam front uses a 170° ultra-wide-angle lens covering more lanes. This will minimize blind spots to assure recording of all events without fail, captures more details, and provides conclusive evidence for the accident.

* Emergency Incident Recording - Built-in G-sensor & active impact monitoring system, this car dash cam can automatically detect sudden shakes, start emergency locked recording to preserve files, offering you the ultimate peace of mind.

* 24/7 Parking Mode - With the help of the mini hardwire kit, the camera for cars can achieve long-time parking monitoring to guard your car in 24 hours while your vehicle is parked. A silent witness you can depend on.

* Withstand Extreme Temperatures - Precision made with premium materials, the dash camera for cars will deliver faultless performance in extreme environments from a harsh Alaskan winter through to the searing heat of a Californian summer. (-4℉ to 140℉).

* Customer Satisfaction Aim - If you have any questions regarding the front camera for cars operation or accessories, iZEEKER dash cam Team will rapidly respond with practical, helpful assistance. Your smile is our No.1 goal.
